title: Elite Gourmet EHC111A Personal Single-Serve Compact Coffee Maker, Black

reviews.title: Solid coffee maker at an unbeatable price ☕️❤️
reviews.body: I have tried many different coffee makers and this one is really a win on both value, ease of use and making a great simple cup of coffee. If you drink one cup of coffee a day this coffee maker would be a great solution for you. I started grinding my own coffee during covid and never went back to k cup pods as the coffee strength Is extremely watered down and not the correct ratio. This coffee maker is easily movable and takes up a very small amount of counter space. It comes with a reusable filter as well that can be emptied out very easily. It makes a perfect cup of 12 oz. The to go cup it comes with also is surprisingly great quality and has a nice padding under the mug to not slide easily. Overall this is an amazing value for a coffee maker that you can use daily or as a backup. ☕️
reviews.date: Reviewed in the United States on July 18, 2026
reviews.author: Cc1

reviews.title: Compact size, great coffee almost anywhere!
reviews.body: I absolutely love this little coffee maker. I bring my favorite beens and my bean grinder and get to have my favorite coffee wherever l go. Includes easy to clean reusable mesh filter, no need for paper filters. Comes with a mini scoop as well, that travels in the water well very nicely. I find 4 mini scoops of ground coffee are just right for a full mug. Love the insulated travel mug it comes with too, nice and hot. The on button sort of pops on when pressed, need to hold it on right side, while pushing power button on left side. I highly recommend!

reviews.title: Great single brew coffee machine for the price
reviews.body: Very impressed with this small inexpensive coffee maker. I was tired of brewing, a whole pot and was looking for something I could just make one cup at a time well this little thing is awesome. I make tea and coffee in it and it can just heat up water also I like the fact that the temperature is hot of my coffee and not lukewarm. I like the mint color because it brightens up my kitchen. The brew time is fast it’s Lil and space-saving. You don’t need a filter and you don’t even know it’s brewing because it’s so quiet.

reviews.author: lyne stokes

reviews.title: A Nice Product at a Good Price - But Keep Looking
reviews.body: So, there are two Keurigs in the office – one on each floor.  Neither one works.I’d found a workaround for the one on 5 – rather than pressing the 12-ounce button, which did absolutely nothing, I’d press the 8-ounce (twice).  Don’t know why it worked but it did.Until it didn’t.Because I don’t like not knowing things (like, how to fix a Keurig, not – you know – calculus), I investigated a fix.  It’s not an uncommon problem, according to Reddit.The fix, while complicated, seems to be effective.However, it’s not something that I’m going to attempt on a machine that is collectively owned.So, I took a popular off-ramp.  I bought my own desk coffee maker.No, it’s not good for team-building and synergy but, trust me, you don’t want to spend time with me, even if I’ve had coffee.It’s small enough that I can stash it in a desk drawer if Building Services comes snooping.It includes the travel cup, so you don’t have to stress over which size to use.The coffee maker itself works fine – I don’t like the cup.For hot coffee, it’s not a long-term storage solution.  It doesn’t cool as quickly as a mug without a lid but it doesn’t hold heat, either.  And unlike ceramic mugs, you can’t reheat it in the microwave.The lid has an unusual design.  To-go cups, from Sheetz or Buc-ees or Wawa, have a plastic peg opposite the opening, which holds the tab closed.  This doesn’t.  Though, it looks like it should.  Each time I take a sip, my nose gets wet because the tab hits my nose.The lid is also a bit challenging to close/seal correctly.  Not once have I screwed it on correctly the first time.It’s a really good one-cup coffee maker for the price and the convenience.But because of my issues with the cup, you can do better.
reviews.date: Reviewed in the United States on September 11, 2025
reviews.author: Nan Reed

reviews.title: Cute and Reliable
reviews.body: This little cutie is perfect. I just needed something that would make one cup of coffee and was not too expensive. The travel mug is a big plus. No searching for cups and it’s a Beautiful mint Green so no one else can claim it. The brew time is quick and reliable. I’ve used cold water bottles straight out of the fridge and the coffee still comes out piping hot. For the price I’m impressed with this gadget. The filter is easy to clean and the coffee mug fits in the cup holder on my lap desk.
reviews.date: Reviewed in the United States on June 8, 2026

reviews.title: Works as intended, didn't last long
reviews.body: I bought this coffee maker in October of 2024, it just died this morning in June 2026. It was a good coffee maker while it lasted, it's easy to clean and easy to use. The single cup brewer I had before this one lasted at least 10 years so I had been hoping to get more life out of this one.

reviews.title: Brews fast and tastes good!
reviews.body: It's fast and brews a good cup of coffee. I love the size, it doesn't take up much space on my counter and it's cute. I ordered a couple more cups for it, which was easy enough as the cup it came with, the bottom started peeling off. I still love it and would buy it again.

reviews.title: Pretty & Plastic
reviews.body: This pretty piece is made of all cheap plastic (all the pretty greenish parts are cheap plastic). It's genius design makes it look good on the countertop and again I just love the pretty color. Outside of the that it gets good and hot - fast. Cheap plastic making fast HOT coffee raises a question of longevity.  I paid $20 for mine and am overall happy with my coffee and my new Coffee maker. I do recommend it. It's good to travel or if you make tea/coffee in your personal office. Space-saver for small areas. Brew time is fast. Water capacity: <>14oz.

features: QUICK INSTANT BREW TIME: With the personal single-serve coffee maker, you can brew fresh coffee at home in under 60 seconds. And immediately take it on the go to reduce precious time in the early mornings.

SINGLE-TOUCH OPERATION: Enjoy hot and freshly brewed coffee with the compact 600-Watt coffee maker. The single-touch operation allows you to quickly brew up to 12 oz. of coffee, consistent to a coffee-house temperature.
INCLUDES TRAVEL MUG: Includes a 12oz. stainless steel insulated travel mug that fits perfectly under the dispenser so fresh coffee is always ready for you. Just Click, Brew and Go!
COMPACT PERSONAL DESIGN: The compact narrow design fits and stores into small or tight spaces. Making it easy for portability for use on vacations, in dorms, offices, or any size kitchen.
